newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle steady $106/dressed, thin-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle steady $106/dressed, thin-USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers picked up slightly on late rounds, and representative sales of both classes were fully steady, USDA said. Confirmed - 4,000 Last Week - 1,000 Last Year - 77,700 Wk To Date- 5,900 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 6,100 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 93,800.
Buyer inquiry was very good. Seller interest only fair, with most pricing cattle above present bids. Slaughter
Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs - few loads 66.00; dressed basis 105.50-106.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs - few loads 66.00; dressed basis 105.00-106.00.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
